comment: Read from src/ConductorExternal at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Conductor - External. The wiki calls the menu item Clear mapping; the item prints Clear mappings (Widget.cpp). The CV 1 jack is given no family because what it wants depends on the mode knob: a level in Index, a trigger in Scroll and a pitch in Note Map. The Note Map quantisation is 24 steps per octave (ConductorExternal.cpp:286), which is quarter-tones rather than semitones. The module's own name in the browser is External MIDI controller expander for Conductor, though nothing about it is specific to MIDI.
